---
$schema: moz://mozilla.org/schemas/glean/metrics/2-0-0
$tags:
  - 'Calendar :: General'

calendar:
  calendar_count:
    type: labeled_string
    description: >
      How many calendars were set up, keyed by calendar type
      Types are e.g. "storage", "caldav", "ics" and various types from add-ons.

---
$schema: moz://mozilla.org/schemas/glean/metrics/2-0-0
$tags:
  - 'Thunderbird :: FileLink'

filelink:
  uploaded_size:
    type: labeled_counter
    description: >
      Accumulated file size (bytes) uploaded to FileLink services, keyed by
      FileLink provider type.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 558 replaces the historical tb category with component categories: mail, addrbook, filelink, compose and calendar. It adds component-relative metrics.yaml files, updates MOZ_GLEAN_EXTRA_METRICS_FILES, changes producers in JavaScript and C++, and changes test lookups. Current configuration retains this placement and adds notifications and Exchange files. A directory move without build registration will not create the expected generated API. Older prose that requires a tb prefix is superseded by these accepted source names. No Glean generation or build was run.
title: Put Glean definitions with the component and register every file
